results.title: Vivo T5e Price in India, Specifications and Features Revealed
results.description: Vivo has launched the T5e in India with a 6.74-inch 90Hz display, Unisoc T7225 processor, 5,500mAh battery, Android 16, and AI-powered features. The entry-level smartphone also offers IP64 protection, expandable storage up to 2TB, and is priced at INR 13,999 for the 4GB+64GB variant.

results.title: Rain or shine, couples are saying ‘I do’ this monsoon
results.description: Monsoon weddings are becoming increasingly popular across Gujarat for couples. Hotels are witnessing a significant rise in wedding bookings during this off-peak season. Couples are drawn to better venue deals and more affordable wedding packages. Wedding planners ensure seamless celebrations by anticipating weather challenges and managing logistics. This trend offers a unique and cost-effective alternative to traditional peak wedding seasons.
